name: Perry Lane Summer Camp
description_short: Agawam's town day camp at Perry Lane Park, open only to Agawam residents who finished kindergarten through grade 8 this school year. The park has an in ground pool, a pavilion, playgrounds and ball fields.
notes: Agawam residents only. Limit 115 campers a session. Extended day AM 7:30 to 9:00 ($36 Session I, $60 Sessions II to IV) and PM 3:30 to 5:30 ($42 and $70), registered in person at 954 Main Street.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Agawam Parks and Recreation payment portal page. Agawam residents only, children who completed kindergarten through those in grade 8 during the 2025 to 2026 school year (grades 1 to 9 entering; ages derived). 9:00 am to 3:30 pm, four sessions June 25 to August 14 (no camp Friday July 3); $156 Session I, $260 Sessions II to IV (two weeks each). Limit 115 campers a session. AM extended day 7:30 to 9:00 am ($36 Session I, $60 others) and PM 3:30 to 5:30 pm ($42, $70). Facilities: in ground pool, pavilion, basketball net, two playgrounds, athletic fields.

source.title: Agawam Parks & Recreation: Perry Lane Summer Camp

for_andrew: Residents only (Agawam). It has one rate per session, recorded as given. List it?
The source is the town's Unibank payment page; no other camp page from the town was found. It names Perry Lane Park but gives no street number, so there is no ZIP and the draft fails validation.

The page has no explicit season year. I took 2026 from 'the 2025 to 2026 school year' and the July 3 closure, which falls on a Friday in 2026. The line 'Registration begins Tuesday April 29' matches 2025, so part of the text may be carried over.
